_metadata.description: Deterministic trace analysis: per-component aggregation, located findings, and before/after comparison.

requirements.title: Per-component trace aggregation
requirements.description: The analysis engine parses the perf trace into a per-component count/avg/max table by pairing ⚛ blink.user_timing begin/end events by id2.local, and extracts long-task and paint/LCP signals from the web-vitals artifact.

validation.notes: Runs against a checked-in fixture trace and asserts the per-component table, long-task totals, and paint/LCP values.

requirements.title: Deterministic located findings
requirements.description: Findings are deterministic (NO AI): each maps a component name to a file:line definition via symbol lookup and carries quantified evidence (count/avg/max, budget delta), emitted through the maturity finding pipeline.

validation.notes: From a fixture trace + fixture source tree, findings carry file:line locations and quantified evidence; no AI call is made.

requirements.title: Before/after comparison primitive
requirements.description: A comparison verb diffs two traces from the same interaction into a per-component delta table (count/avg/total) plus a long-task delta, surfacing the case where commit cardinality changes but per-commit cost drops.

validation.notes: Two fixture traces produce a delta table with b-cnt/a-cnt/b-avg/a-avg columns and a long-task delta line.
